## 9. Practitioner observations as research prompts

[Procurement&Beyond episode
8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5KYUdTLlvvg) raises practical questions about
internal ownership, process friction, requirement discipline, operational
purchasing, policy simplification, TCO and bounded use of AI. The recording is
in Polish and its transcript provenance is automatic YouTube captions.

The material informs interview prompts and hypotheses only. It cannot set a
workflow duration, cost, competition stress, readiness responses or threshold.
Bielik may structure market data for human review. The deterministic model
performs the calculation.
